title: Purple Slime Monster
description: A large, glossy purple slime creature with two bright green eyes and an orange smiling mouth dominates the center of the frame. It has multiple dripping tentacles and stands before a dark industrial complex with rusted towers and pipes set against a twilight forest under a purple and orange sky.
prompt: A large glossy purple slime monster with big round green eyes and a wide orange smile, multiple thick dripping tentacles, wet glistening surface, standing in front of a decaying industrial factory complex with rusted towers and pipes, dark pine forest in the background, dramatic purple and orange twilight sky with floating arcane symbols, moody atmospheric lighting, dark fantasy style
